Jared Moskowitz (HBO)Real Time with Bill Maher1.1M views • 1 day agoLivePlaylist ()Mix (50+) NaN / NaN Comments 355 Top comments Newest first Description BBC boss resigns in shame after damning story of doctored Trump footage breaks 1.2KLikes17,579Views1hAgo The BBC director general Tim Davie and the CEO of News Deborah Turness resigned over the misleading edit of US President Donald Trump on Sunday. The resignation comes after the BBC was exposed for airing a doctored speech by Donald Trump leading up to the Capitol Hill riots in 2021. A week before the 2024 presidential election, a BBC Panorama programme broadcast the edited version of Trump's speech that misled viewers. Davie became the leader of the British Broadcasting Corporation in 2020 and had worked at the company for 20 years. Trump took to his social media platform Truth Social to blast Davie and applaud The Telegraph, which broke the story. …...more ...more Show less Transcript Follow along using the transcript.
